citations.quote: 一季度盈警+上海信封+大爆炸，是一個很好的機會與之共患難
五六月除淨的港股，很多都是七月份才派股息，不應太悲觀
如果今天$恒生指数(HKHSI)$ 再不跟$道琼斯指数(.DJI)$，大概可以判断港股已經跌不下去了，五窮六絕到此結束

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: In June 2022 the author treated a clustered-bad-news trough on a cyclical H-share — Q1 profit warning, the Shanghai lockdown (his oblique 上海信封), and a plant explosion — as a 共患難 (share-hardship) entry opportunity; separately he read HK 五窮六絕 seasonality against the July dividend-payment calendar and used HSI-vs-Dow decoupling as a hedged, probabilistic bottoming tell.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Contrarian Entry on Clustered Bad News: 共患難 at the Sentiment Trough, 五窮六絕 vs the Dividend Calendar, and the HSI-vs-Dow Bottoming Tell
